page: Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor. The system is equipped with 672.0 GB of system memory, which yields a memory-to-core ratio of 7.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 2458 GB local SSD. It is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature any GPU hardware accelerators.

The high memory-to-vCPU ratio and the inclusion of a large local SSD provide resource density for memory-intensive workloads. This hardware profile is configured for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, data warehousing, and relational database management systems that require substantial local scratch space and high memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
